remarks: Beautiful renovated Townhouse style condo in Norwalk. On the main level an ample living room, dining room and kitchen with hardwood floors all over; and a convenient half bathroom for visitors. Sliding doors from the dining room takes you to private deck with an amazing view. At the upper level, two ample bedrooms with spacious closets in each one, the full bathroom, and access to attic for additional storage. In the lower level you will find the laundry area, a bonus room for office, exercise or just additional seating, and garage for one car. Plenty of parking space for you and visitors. This condo has everything you need, including the inground pool to enjoy in the summer days. Offering 1 year lease. Asking for credit 600+, first month rent, one month security deposit and renters insurance.
